references.role: approved Covenant creature anatomy, palette and style

input.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original painted game character ANIMATION SHEET on uniform vivid MAGENTA #FF00FF. Reference-1.png is the exact character identity and equipment reference. Reference-2.png is the APPROVED COVENANT CREATURE SOURCE, the authority for anatomy, palette and painting style. Use BOTH references visually. Match its lighter stylized painted values and simple sculpted shapes exactly; do not darken into realistic horror, add photoreal skin or fur, or add black shadows. Reference-1 is an A10 master or a crop of that approved source. Generate the requested anatomical view even if the reference is a rear view. This is an ANIMAL ONLY. No human body, no clothes, no weapon or staff, no hands. Keep its exact creature anatomy. For ALL poses the camera sees BACK surfaces. During collapse fall FORWARD AWAY from the camera, finally FACE-DOWN with the back uppermost and the face HIDDEN. Never turn to face the viewer, never roll onto the back. Raw magical low lean canine made of charcoal-black cracked stone hide, ember seams, angular pointed ears, long jointed legs, compact flame tail. Four legs and distinct lean hound muzzle; no gore. REAR-RIGHT three-quarter view, head and torso facing diagonally AWAY from viewer and toward image RIGHT, back surfaces visible. Maintain this anatomical view for every pose, including resting body; do not rotate a flat upright sprite. Camera elevated 55-degree orthographic, not eye-level. Exactly FIVE columns and TWO rows: TEN complete poses, same anatomical scale, no text. Read left to right: poses 1-4 QUICK FLINCH: 1 ready; 2 head and shoulders jerk backward visibly; 3 legs catch balance; 4 fully recovered ready. Poses 5-10 HEAVY STAGGER: 5 ready; 6 abrupt head and torso recoil; 7 deepest hunched recoil and visibly lost balance; 8 legs splay and bend to catch weight; 9 pushing back toward ready; 10 fully recovered ready. Show clear torso articulation and varied leg support; not repeated standing duplicates. Keep FOUR animal feet and natural creature anatomy, no rearing, no human arms. No falling or lying poses in this sheet. The difference between ready and peak recoil must read at small game size. Wide empty gutters, no clipped parts. Each equal cell contains ONE entire body at IDENTICAL anatomical scale. Each body and all equipment fit within middle 60% of the cell, including lying poses. Wide completely empty magenta gutters. No text, numbers, labels, panel borders, shadows, floor, scene, magic aura, extra figures or chopped anatomy. Do not let staff, tail, wing or foot cross a cell boundary. Original hand-painted digital dark fantasy. Sculpted painterly volume, broken confident contours, sharply selected silver highlights, worn dark metal and pale layered cloth. Material wear only at physical edges, broad quiet ground planes and smooth opaque paint. No grain, paper, canvas texture, noise overlay, stippling, photorealism or 3D render. Roman culture supplies arena masonry and ordinary legion equipment; magical figures and creatures are raw original fantastical designs. Shared cool upper-left light and small contact shadows. Smooth opaque painted cloth and metal, rich physical volume, no heavy cartoon outline. Sheet aspect 1:1. Original designs only.
input.referenceConsumption: agy receives all named image references; creatures always include original approved Covenant creature source; Grok wrapper consumes first identity image only, Covenant style block is textual

arguments.Prompt:
Original hand-painted game character 2D animation sprite sheet on solid uniform vivid MAGENTA #FF00FF background. Character identity matching Reference-1 and Reference-2: Cinder hound, a raw magical low lean quadruped canine beast made of charcoal-black cracked stone hide, glowing orange-red ember seams, angular pointed ears, long jointed four legs with animal paws, and a compact flame tail. Distinct lean hound muzzle, quadruped animal anatomy only, no human features, no gear, no weapons, no clothes.

Grid layout: Exactly 5 columns and 2 rows, containing exactly 10 complete poses arranged in a clean 5x2 grid. Equal cell spacing with wide completely empty vivid magenta #FF00FF gutters between all cells. No cell borders, no grid lines, no text, no numbers, no labels, no floor plane, no ground shadows, no background elements. Every pose fits comfortably entirely within the middle 60% of its cell without clipping or crossing cell borders.

Perspective and Camera: Elevated 55-degree orthographic isometric camera angle. REAR-RIGHT three-quarter view (head and torso facing diagonally AWAY from the camera and toward image RIGHT, dorsal back surfaces visible to viewer). Maintain this exact rear-right three-quarter angle for every pose across the entire sheet.

Poses sequence (left-to-right, top-to-bottom):
Top row (Poses 1 to 5):
Pose 1: Ready idle stance, low lean cinder hound alert.
Pose 2 (Quick Flinch 1): Head and shoulders jerk backward visibly from impact recoil.
Pose 3 (Quick Flinch 2): Four legs shift and catch balance, absorbing hit.
Pose 4 (Quick Flinch 3): Fully recovered ready stance.
Pose 5 (Heavy Stagger 1): Ready stance before heavy impact.

Bottom row (Poses 6 to 10):
Pose 6 (Heavy Stagger 2): Abrupt sharp recoil, head and torso thrown backward violently.
Pose 7 (Heavy Stagger 3): Deepest hunched recoil, body compressed backward with visibly lost balance.
Pose 8 (Heavy Stagger 4): Legs splay wide and bend deeply to brace and catch falling weight.
Pose 9 (Heavy Stagger 5): Straining and pushing forward back toward ready stance.
Pose 10 (Heavy Stagger 6): Fully recovered balanced ready stance.

Style and Rendering: Hand-painted digital dark fantasy art style matching Reference-1 and Reference-2. Sculpted painterly volume, sharp highlights, glowing internal ember cracks, cool upper-left lighting, smooth opaque brushwork. High contrast against vivid flat magenta #FF00FF background. Identical anatomical scale across all 10 figures.
